name: Zweibrücken (Germany)
description: Horizontal tricolour of blue, yellow and red, charged at the centre with the city arms of Zweibrücken (a red lion on yellow with a blue bridge).
history: Municipal flag of Zweibrücken; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Zweibrücken arms — lion with bridge on yellow
